verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm, but it offers a client-facing platform workflow (Lowenstein x Clerky) and publishes an llms.txt, so asking about a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this offering. The evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and llms.txt is an overview file, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
